spec.name: v01_exact_repro
spec._hypothesis: Exact re-run of the claimed spec.

spec.name: v04_topn60
spec._hypothesis: Breadth: if the ranking has real information, edge should decay smoothly, not vanish.

spec.name: v09_anti_mr5
spec._hypothesis: ANTI-STRATEGY: exact mirror of mr5. If mr5's ranking carries real cross-sectional information, this must show a clearly NEGATIVE edge of similar magnitude. If it is also >= 0, the measured 'edge' is not coming from the ranking.

spec.name: v10_sector_winner
spec._hypothesis: Mirror of the dominant leg: buy sector-relative WINNERS. Should be the negative of rb1 if the effect is a monotone ranking effect.

spec.name: v13_placebo_skew
spec._hypothesis: PLACEBO: unrelated factor on the identical exit/top_n, therefore judged against the identical control draw. If unrelated factors also print positive validate+holdout edges, the control draw - not the signal - is producing them.

spec.name: v14_placebo_illiq
spec._hypothesis: PLACEBO 2: unrelated factor, identical exit/top_n and control draw.

spec.name: v15_placebo_voltrend
spec._hypothesis: PLACEBO 3: unrelated factor, identical exit/top_n and control draw.

spec.name: v16_placebo_neg_illiq
spec._hypothesis: PLACEBO 4: the mirror of placebo 2. Paired with v14 this measures how wide the spread of 'edges' is for signals with no thesis behind them.
